Author: ApryllForever

Iridium Bomb: 
﻿
﻿ ﻿Radius: 11 (MegaBomb has a radius of 7)
﻿ ﻿Damage: 433
﻿ ﻿Recipe: 1 Mega Bomb, 2 Refined Quartz

Iridium Cluster Bomb:

﻿﻿Radius: 7 (MegaBomb has a radius of 7)
﻿Damage: 199 + 99 + 99
﻿Note: This bomb creates two blasts, is designed to kill mummies.
﻿Recipe: 3 Cherry Bombs, 2 Refined Quartz

There is a config for a delay. The default is 2 seconds, to allow for getting out of the blast radius.

[center][font=Times New Roman][color=#8e7cc3][size=5]Where To Get Them:[/size][/color][/font][/center]

Both bombs, and their recipes, are sold at the Volcano Dwarf Shop.
